Decisions raised: (1) B3-21/B3-24/B3-27 wording 'cancel payment/email' contradicts CALL-02 B2/M14 (re-run payments+comms, same outbox id v+1); default follows B2, rerun_effects=False gives the issue wording (tested). (2) CR to maya: RestoreStep.to optional for culprit-created objects; interim encoding to=VersionRef(ver=expect.ver, hash=TOMBSTONE_HASH), reason tainted_create, restores_to_absent(). (3) CR: RecoveryPlan field for t0_seq_est_literal. 'Plan file outside the run dir' read as: write_plan takes an explicit dir and refuses one under the run dir. Suite 734 passed/8 skipped; container 742 passed.

Accepted as interim: missing outbox:<id> counts as held until B3-23, with the note shown; a dispatched item of a re-run is flagged conservatively until B3-24 compares payload hashes (ADR-05 s6.3).
